text: Grounded today via Playwright: RichMarkdown IS wired, bodies ARE in data (sections 500-650 chars), but PLAN=index-only + SPEC near-threshold unreached@173% + task=header-only. So it is a reveal/threshold bug, not a missing renderer.

Root cause confirmed by opus: CanvasView.tsx:273 (global contentNear=scale>=1.3) + SectionNode.tsx:133 (!isPlan plan-body gate). Per-node appW band fixes both — bodies reveal at W2 for plan AND spec AND task.

Assigned to fresh FE 938b4465 as the HEADLINE fix: delete CanvasView.tsx:273 global raw-scale contentNear + remove SectionNode.tsx:133 !isPlan gate → per-node appW W0-W3; body reveals at W2 for SPEC+PLAN+TASK. This is Andrey #1 complaint (text in the plan).

BUG FIXED (Andrey #1 no real text in the plan): deleted CanvasView.tsx contentNear=scale>=1.3 global flag AND SectionNode.tsx !isPlan body gate. SPEC section bodies, PLAN per-row markdown excerpts (W2) / fuller (W3), and TASK body + model_rationale + step cards all REVEAL on zoom — no titles-only, no click-toggles. RichMarkdown was already wired; it was a per-node threshold bug.

Visual proof at W2/W3 (screenshot /tmp/worlds-shots/06-zoom.png): SPEC node shows full prose, task card Rex shows status Done + model codex:gpt-5.5 + Why this model? rationale + body + a Status Update step card with milestone text. done-status task dims ~0.7, in_progress gets accent ring (pulse at W0). Crossfade = opacity + 4px rise, no geometry reflow.
Body-reveal headline bug DONE — text now shows in plan/spec/task on zoom (Andrey #1 complaint resolved). Live on dev 7686, build 00dcd1ed.
